quandoUsar: Fixed-length verification code, sent by email or SMS or generated by an authenticator app, typed cell by cell.
When pasting the whole code needs to work: the pasted text is distributed across the cells starting from the focused one.
quandoEvitar: Use `sign-in` when you want the whole email-and-code flow already assembled, with resend and account state.
Use `input` for variable-length codes or codes with separators, such as coupons and recovery keys.
Use `password-field` for secrets that should not appear on screen; here the characters are visible.

teclado.acao: Move focus to the previous or next cell.
In an empty cell, clears the previous cell and moves focus to it.
Clears the character in the focused cell.
Pastes the code starting from the focused cell; in numeric mode, anything that is not a digit is discarded.
Go through each cell: all of them are independent fields in the focus order.

acessibilidade: The cells form a `role="group"` with an `aria-label` coming from `label`, and each field identifies itself as “digit N of M”, in English hardcoded in the file.
`description` and `error` are linked to all cells by `aria-describedby`; with an error, the cells receive `aria-invalid` and the message is a `role="alert"`.
The first cell uses `autoComplete="one-time-code"`; in forced colors the animated ring disappears and the native focus outline returns.
movimento: Each digit rises into the cell from a slight blur; when pasting, the digits arrive in a wave from left to right.
A single focus ring slides between cells with a short spring, and a new error shakes the row sideways once, with the message opening its own height.
With “reduce motion” on, digits only fade, the ring jumps between cells, there is no shake, and messages appear without animation.
responsivo: The cells are 42 × 48 px and shrink in width when the row does not fit; up to 360 px of viewport the gap between them drops to 6 px and the height to 44 px.
notasIA: It is controlled only: without `value` and `onChange` the typed digits do not appear; `onChange` returns the compact string, so check `value.length === length` to validate or submit.
`label` is required; `length` is 6 by default, `inputMode="text"` accepts letters, and passing a new `error` triggers the shake.

Import from `@/components/ryan-ui/otp-input/otp-input` (it does not live in `blocks/`); there is no `onComplete`, and `sign-in` and `login-centered` show how to submit when the last cell is completed.
